reply_text:
I've recorded Tobias's correction. The Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is now on record as **84 seats**.

- **GBrain:** It had one saved fact for Marrow Agrisupply: 382 seats, from Tobias's #central-team post this morning. I saved the 84-seat figure as a new fact, with this #central-random message as the source. I then withdrew the 382 fact, noting that this correction replaces it, so it no longer comes back in searches. The record of the change is kept.
- **Reply to Tobias:** I answered in the thread on his message in #central-random, saying the record is updated and nothing else is needed. I left the old figure out of the reply because it was posted in #central-team, and not everyone in #central-random may be in that channel.

Nothing else was needed: Tobias asked for no action, and seat counts aren't finance figures, so no approval applies. The 84 is what he reported; I haven't checked it against a contract. GBrain ran keyword-only search, so it couldn't look for the old figure saved in different wording. The only Marrow fact it found was the one I withdrew.
